t: Sukka shechammatah merubba mitztzillatah veyeter dine hassekak
s: Sukka shechammatah merubba mitztzillatah veyeter dine hassekak ubo y"b seipim: haya hassekak kissuy daq meod sheyyesh bo avir harbeh, ella sheen shelosha tepachim avir bemaqom echad, uben hakkol tzillato merubba mechammato shehassekak hi merubba min haavir — hare zo keshera:

Abal im en hassekak merubbeh min haavir ella hen shavin — pesula, lepi shehachamma hannikneset baavir hassikkuk keshehi maggia leqarqait hassukka hi mitpashshetet yoter mimmah shehi lemala baavir hassikkuk, venimtza shehassukka lematta beqarqaitah hi chammatah merubba mitztzillatah:

Abal im lematta beqarqaitah hi chammatah vetzillatah shavin — keshera, lepi sheyyadua shellemala behassekak haavir hu muat min hassikkuk vetzillatah lemala hi merubba mechammatah, vahare zeh sekak gamur:

Veim rob sekak tzillatah merubbeh mechammatah shette mashshehuyin, shehaavir shebbo hu muat meod, umiut hassekak chammato merubba mitztzillato mashshehu, beinyan sheim netzarep hachamma vehatztzel shel kol hassikkuk yihyeh tzillato merubba mechammato mashshehu — hare zo keshera, umuttar lesheb apillu tachat miut hassekak shechammato merubba, lepi shehu batel legabbe rob hassekak shetztzillato merubba. Mikkol maqom, im miut hassekak shechammato merubba yesh bo shiba tepachim al shiba tepachim kede shiur heksher sukka — en lesheb tachtayv, lepi shehu maqom chashub veeno batel legabbe shear hassekak shetztzillato merubba:

Lekattechilla tzarik laasot et hassikkuk qal veqalush beinyan sheyyihyu hakkokabim haggedolim nirim mittoko ballayla, ubediabad apillu hayeta meubba kemin bayit ad sheen zaharure shemesh nirim mittokah — keshera. Vehu sheyyakol hammatar lered betokah, abal im haya hassekak meubbeh kol kak ad sheen hammatar yakol lered betokah — pesula, lepi sheen niqret sukka ella im ken enah meginna ella min hatztzel bilbad, abal im meginna gam min hammatar — en niqret sukka, ella kemin bayit hi zo:

Haya hassikkuk mebulbal, dehaynu shemmiqtzato oleh meat lemala umiqtzato yored meat lematta, ap al pi shemmittok kak chammatah merubba mitztzillatah — keshera, shekkevan sheim taamod hachamma beemtza haraqia keneged rosh kol adam yihyeh tzillatah merubba mechammatah — en lipsol otah mechamat chamma habbaa min hatztzad baalakson:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen baggobah shebben haoleh lehayyored g' tepachim, shekkol pachot mig' tepachim hare hu kelabud umitztorpin zeh im zeh lihyot niqraim sekak echad, abal im yesh benehem shelosha tepachim — en mitztorpin zeh im zeh, veen zeh chashub sekak kelal. Veim yesh berochab hassikkuk haoleh keshiur gag dehaynu tepach al tepach o yoter vehu mekuvvan keneged haavir shebben hattachton, ap al pi sheyyesh benehem yoter mig' tepachim — keshera, lepi sheanu roim et haoleh keillu yarad lematta umunnach baavir shekkenegdo. Vehu sheyyehe rochab haavir kerochab haoleh o yoter mimmennu, abal im haya pachot mimmennu, veken im haoleh eno mekuvvan mammash keneged haavir shettachtayv, beinyan sheim haya yored lematta kenegdo mammash haya miqtzato nogea bassekak hattachton — en anu roin oto keillu yarad lematta. Vekol shiurin hallalu hen halaka lemosheh missinay:

Qanim hayyotzeim meachore hassukka ushette depanot nimshakim immahem, kegon sheachore dopen emtzai shel hassukka boletin qanim mehassekak, veyesh bahen heksher sukka dehaynu shiba tepachim al shiba tepachim, vetzillatan merubba mechammatan, veyesh lahem shalosh depanot dehaynu dopen haemtzai shel hassukka vekol depanot haarukkot hannimshakot immahem — hare zo sukka gemura ukeshera, ap al pi sheddopen haemtzai lo naasa bishbilah ella bishbil iqqar hassukka:

Veken qanim habboletim mehassekak letzad ruach rebiit hassukka shehu parutz veen bo dopen, vedopen echad nimshak mehassukka im qanim ellu sheyyesh bahem heksher sukka — hare maqom zeh nechshab gam ken min hassukka, umuttar lesheb sham ap al pi sheen sham ella dopen echad. Vaapillu im baal hassukka gilla dato shekkavvanato hayeta laasot kol hassukka bidpanot arukkot hannimshakot im kol orek hassekak, kegon shelleachar sheasa dopen echad arok beorek kol hassekak asa dopen shekkenegdo arok yoter mishshiba tepachim — en omerim kevan shehaya day ledopen shelishi hazzeh laasoto shiba tepachim bilbad vezeh sheheeriko yoter gilla dato shekkavvanato lehamshik haddepanot im hassekak shello lesheb tachat hassekak happarutz sheen shette depanot nimshakot immah, veim ken dopen zeh hannimshak im qanim ellu habboletim min hassekak en nechshab kelal min hassukka ella bipne atzmo hu omed, venimtza sheen leqanim ellu raq dopen echad dehaynu dopen hannimshak immahem — en anu omerim ken, mishshum sheen anu holekin achar gilluy dato bazeh (lepi sheasiyyat hassukka enah tzerika kavvana kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"h), ukeillu lo gilla dato kelal, shekkol hassekak mitkashsher baddopen hashshelishi hazzeh haqqatzar ap al pi sheeno nimshak im kol orek hassekak kemo shennimshak dopen shekkenegdo, ukemo shennitbaer besiman tr"l:

Kebar bearnu besiman trk"v sheim sikkek biskak pasul ubiskak kasher veenan meorabin zeh im zeh ella kol echad veechad munnach al hassukka bipne atzmo zeh betzad zeh — eno tzarik sheyyihyeh bassekak hakkasher rob keneged happasul, ella apillu im hen mechetza al mechetza gam ken hassukka keshera, shekkak hu halaka lemosheh missinay shehassekak hatztzarik lehassukka eno tzarik lihyot rob min hakkasher lesikkuk ella chatzi hassekak bilbad. Vehu shello yihyeh missekak happasul arbaa tepachim bemaqom echad besukka gedola, o shelosha tepachim besukka qetanna sheen bah ki im shiba tepachim al shiba tepachim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"b, ayyen sham:

Vaapillu im sekak hakkasher hu qal veqalush kedino, beinyan shehakkokabim nirim mittoko usekak happasul en hakkokabim nirim mittoko (ketzad? Kegon shessikkek beshappudin, shehen sekak pasul, vehinniach revach ben shappud leshappud kimlo shappud venatan sham sekak kasher qal veqalush kedino, venimtza shessekak happasul hu merubbeh al hakkasher keshiur haorek shebbassekak hakkasher shehakkokabim nirim mittokah, mikkol maqom kevan sheorek verochab maqom hamsukkak biskak kasher hu keorek verochab maqom hamsukkak biskak pasul) — hare zo keshera min hattora. Ella shellepi shehaadam i epshar lo letzamtzem lemalleot kol haavir shebben shappud leshappud biskak kasher shello yihyeh shum avir mashshehu ben hashshappud lassekak hakkasher, venimtza shessekak happasul hu merubbeh al hakkasher, shehare en ben shappud leshappud ella kimlo shappud betzimtzum, vegam maqom zeh eno male missekak kasher ella nishar avir mashshehu beno lassekak happasul, lepikak en sukka zo keshera ella im ken hedip meat sekak hakkasher unetano al happasul, sheaz bevadday nitkassa kol haavir shebben shappud leshappud. Veken im hayu hashshappudin netunin sheti, dehaynu leorek hassukka, vehaqqanim shel sekak hakkasher netunim ereb, dehaynu lerochab hassukka, sheaz al korchak im eno noten rashe haqqanim al hashshappud hare hen nopelim laaretz, veim ken al korchak bevadday mitkasseh kol haavir velo nishar apillu avir mashshehu ben hashshappudin lassekak hakkasher:

Bayit hamqoreh binsarim sheen alehem maaziba (perush ritzpat tit shemmesimin alehem) uba lehakshiro lesheb tachtehen leshem sukka, shehare nesarim ellu hem pesulim lesikkuk apillu en berochban arbaa tepachim, lepi shello hunnechu kan leshem tzel ella leshem dira, ketzad makshiran? Notel neser echad mibben shenayim veyitten sekak kasher bimqomah, vechozer venotel neser echad veyitten sekak kasher bimqomah, vetihyeh keshera kol hassukka: chaser
